data.title: Wallbox sells ABL connectivity unit in deal with Famatel
data.description:
• Wallbox (WBX) sold ABL GmbH's Connectivity business to Famatel, as the EV charging company continues to streamline its operations and focus on its core business.
  • The transaction includes the transfer of the business's assets, proprietary technologies, products and operations, along with employees assigned to the unit. It also includes the shares of ABL Morocco S.A., a subsidiary located in Tangier, Morocco, which will no longer be part of the Wallbox Group.
  • ABL's eMobility business, including its EV charging product portfolio, will remain part of Wallbox.
  • The agreement was signed and the transaction closed on November 16, 2026.
  • The stock price increased about 4% on Thursday pre-market trade.

data.title: Redwire awarded $15M solar array contract from AscendArc
data.description:
• Redwire (RDW) on Thursday said it was awarded an approximately $15 million contract to deliver its Extensible Low-Profile Solar Array wings to AscendArc, a developer of geosynchronous satellites, in Q3 FY2026. 
  • The ELSA wings will be used to power AscendArc’s GEO communications stackable satellite. 
  • Press release

data.title: Coherent stock jumps on $2B share buyback plan
data.description:
• Coherent (COHR) has authorized a $2B share repurchase program, allowing the company to buy back its common stock through open-market purchases, negotiated transactions, accelerated buybacks, block trades, Rule 10b5-1 plans, put options and other derivative transactions.
  • The program has no expiration date and does not obligate Coherent to repurchase any specific number of shares.
  • Shares rose 7% premarket to $228.

data.title: Brightstar Lottery CEO steps down, ACI Worldwide head to take over
data.description:
• Brightstar Lottery (BRSL) said that CEO Vince Sadusky will retire from his role and the company's board of directors, effective January 1, 2027.
  • Thomas Warsop, who most recently served as CEO of ACI Worldwide (ACIW), has been appointed to succeed Sadusky and will also join Brightstar's board on the same date.
  • Warsop served as CEO of ACI Worldwide from November 2022 to November 2026 and was a member of its board from June 2015 to November 2026. He previously held several leadership positions, including Group President at Fiserv (FISV) from 2007 to 2012.
